key_highlights: ASX slumped on bond-market volatility; unemployment hit 5-year high of 4.6% in August, yet RBA signals further rate hikes
AUD weakened sharply against USD amid US economic outperformance and Trump policy uncertainty
Miners rose on gold/rare-earths momentum while oil and coal stocks struggled; IDP plunged
Trump diesel export ban threat raises fuel-price and energy-security risks for Australia
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags structural fiscal pressure, reinforcing tax-reform debate
Industrial action at Jetstar and Sydney Airport disrupts transport sector operations
Property market cooling: rising listings and falling demand pressuring prices; over half of renters financially stressed

sectors.trend: Mixed: gold and rare-earths names outperform on exploration catalysts (Forrestania, Critical Resources, Aurum, Lindian, Critica); coal and oil laggards pressured by policy uncertainty and rehabilitation disputes
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX) and rare-earths (LRE.AX, CRG.AX) offer relative strength; coal (BHP.AX coal segment, WDS.AX) faces structural headwinds from mine-abandonment disputes and energy transition

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish bias despite 4.6% unemployment supports net interest margins but raises credit-risk concerns; Intergenerational Report flags long-term fiscal strain
sectors.implications: Big Four (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) benefit from higher rates short-term but face rising NPLs as household stress (renters, middle-income) intensifies; ASX200 Financials index under pressure

sectors.trend: Fuel-price fears from potential US diesel ban and drying global buffers; political energy-cost debate; nuclear-energy debate gains traction
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) face policy risk; retail fuel margins compressed; nuclear advocacy could benefit uranium names (NUE.AX, LEM.AX) long-term

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action and Sydney Airport strikes disrupt travel; household affordability crisis with >50% of renters struggling
sectors.implications: QAN.AX (Qantas) and airline sector face operational disruption; consumer discretionary (WES.AX, WOW.AX) pressured by weak consumer confidence

sectors.trend: Aussie tech firm ($16b) faces China-link scrutiny; Meta AI rollout lifts global tech sentiment; Medicare AI hack raises data-security concerns
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) face geopolitical risk; CSL.AX and healthcare sector relatively insulated but watch AI-cybersecurity regulation

sectors.trend: Rising listings and falling demand driving prices lower; Chinese property recovery uncertain
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face cap-rate pressure; watch Chinese property recovery for AP REIT exposure

key_themes: RBA hawkish divergence: hiking despite 4.6% unemployment tests credibility and household resilience
AUD/USD weakness driven by US outperformance and Trump policy volatility
Trump trade/energy policy (diesel ban, tariffs) as primary external risk to Australian energy security
Gold and rare-earths exploration pipeline accelerating across WA and Africa
Intergenerational Report 2026 reinforcing structural fiscal and tax-reform narrative
Industrial action (Jetstar, airport, teachers) creating operational and consumer-disruption risk
Household affordability crisis: renter stress, middle-income divergence, property cooling

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike amid rising unemployment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate sensitivity via long-duration bonds; reduce leverage in rate-sensitive REITs and property exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Trump diesel export ban / energy supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify energy exposure; monitor WDS.AX, STO.AX; consider uranium/nuclear names as structural hedge
Hedge USD-denominated liabilities; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor ^AXJO foreign-inflow data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Household credit stress and rising NPLs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Screen bank NPL trajectories; favour CBA.AX, NAB.AX with stronger balance sheets; avoid high-LVR REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Industrial action disrupting transport and services
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce QAN.AX and travel-linked exposure short-term; monitor Jetstar (QAN.AX subsidiary) and airport operators

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Coal mine rehabilitation disputes and policy risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid coal-exposed miners (WDS.AX coal segment); favour diversified majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX)

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven and exploration catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 210k oz upgrade, Critical Resources Suriname grab, Aurum $52.5M raise signal sector momentum; gold benefits from AUD weakness and global uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Selective rare-earths exposure on offtake and production milestones
opportunities.rationale: Lindian Malawian production nearing, Critica Jupiter offtake progress; structural demand from EV/defence supply chains

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on Big Four banks on NIM expansion
opportunities.rationale: RBA hawkish bias supports margins; CBA and NAB show relative credit strength amid household stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce energy and oil-stock exposure; hedge fuel-price risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Trump diesel ban threat and drying global buffers create asymmetric downside; energy policy uncertainty elevated
Rising listings, falling demand, renter stress, and RBA hikes pressure valuations; Chinese property recovery unconfirmed

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim transport and consumer-discretionary names amid industrial action
defensive_moves.rationale: Jetstar and airport strikes disrupt operations; consumer confidence weak with affordability crisis

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure (1–3 months) as RBA hikes, AUD weakens, and Trump policy volatility dominates. Miners (gold/rare-earths) outperform; energy, property, and consumer lag. Bond-market volatility a key swing factor.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots post-hike cycle and global growth stabilises. Intergenerational Report tax reform could unlock fiscal space. Gold and rare-earths structural themes persist. Property stabilisation depends on rate path and immigration policy.
